verdict.rationale: Caveman documents automations that run by hand, on a schedule or on a GitHub event, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. The change history it does document covers budgets, guardrails, keys and roles, not automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Change summaries and graded changes describe agent work output, not automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
